[EN] The {@Rgn:49005$$Casian Tree} northeast of us attracts unique argons. They're good sport, and hunting them protects the tree.

{@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} will get you started.
[ES] El {@Rgn:49005$$Casian Tree} al noreste de nosotros atrae argons únicos. Son una buena presa y cazarlos protege el árbol.

{@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} te pondrá en marcha.

[EN] Oh, the {@Rgn:49005$$Casian Tree} is crawling with uglies today.

There are {@LinkCreature:49#20#zariik workers}, {@LinkCreature:49#19#spodas}, and {@LinkCreature:49#15#yusul slashers}.
[ES] Oh, el {@Rgn:49005$$Casian Tree} está lleno de horrores hoy.

Hay {@LinkCreature:49#20#zariik workers}, {@LinkCreature:49#19#spodas} y {@LinkCreature:49#15#yusul slashers}.

[EN] Interesting, aren't they? Unlike any other argons I've seen.
[ES] Interesantes, ¿no? A diferencia de cualquier otro argon que haya visto.
